scope: Initial six discovered Android V6 PDF report generators; more may be discovered in V7-R01
note: Existing original Android PDFs from V6 provide a baseline but this template must not claim V7 visual audit, correctness or implementation. Rule G04 is scientifically condition-dependent, not universally GHS-applicable.

rules.short: Gauges and statistically justified exceedance analyses
True bilingual Arabic-first content; 0-9 numerals in plots
Efficient A4 information density without overlaps
Amber-yellow/black bold table headers and black borders
Every chart provides new evidence-based interpretive value
Engine decisions are authoritative; PDF performs no second scientific eligibility gating.
White page content; black, white, orange-yellow, gray brand; only dark clear additional chart colors.
Report header uses original measurement date and time or authentic date range, never export time substitution.
Black header: logo right, bilingual 15pt bold amber title center, white capture timestamp left; tight margins, line 1.15, paragraph 0, cell padding 2mm x 1mm.
Light gray footer: Arabic page n/N left black 14pt bold and two-color HazRob wordmark right.

report_records.expected_mq: MQ and Rs/R0 only when valid
special: GHS and exposure limits only for a source-qualified identity, otherwise a segregated reference section
Single snapshot must not imply TWA or temporal distribution
Evidence tier UNKNOWN and physical G3=0 protected
Explain executed inference methods rather than listing an unverified number of techniques
report_records.risk: Unqualified gas identity or ppm deemed safety measurement
